title: What a project costs to keep running

metrics.name: heroku.cost_usd_month
metrics.label: хостинг $/мес
metrics.means: Estimated monthly cost from published on-demand dyno rates and billed_price for add-ons owned by the project's applications. Attached add-ons owned elsewhere are excluded to avoid double counting. This is a capacity estimate, not an invoice or a measurement of per-second billing.

metrics.name: heroku.dynos
metrics.label: дино
metrics.means: How many dynos the project's applications have scaled, summed across them. The companion to the cost: a bill that grew because a worker was added is a different fact from one that grew because a dyno was resized, and the two are indistinguishable from money alone.

why: Preserve daily snapshots of the registry's estimated monthly Heroku cost and scaled dynos. Comparing the series helps distinguish scaling changes from changes in application size or add-on ownership.
